items.statement: The submission independently identifies and preserves the three state identities and candidate site/magnetic arrangements rather than reporting an untraceable selected structure.
items.expected: UC-1, UC-2 and UC-3 are distinguishable and candidate coverage/selection context is retained. Use the public fixed-cell 56-atom, one-Fe model with exact UC counts and neutral electronic compensation; no extra ionic defects. Nominal Fe3+ and UC-3 +2 bookkeeping do not establish final oxidation state. Full nominal shells, atom/image trace, topology and coverage are required.

items.statement: Candidate advancement is tied to convergence, structural integrity and reproducible geometry extraction.
items.expected: Reported candidates include explicit validation evidence and local-geometry definitions. Use the public fixed-cell 56-atom, one-Fe model with exact UC counts and neutral electronic compensation; no extra ionic defects. Nominal Fe3+ and UC-3 +2 bookkeeping do not establish final oxidation state. Full nominal shells, atom/image trace, topology and coverage are required.

items.statement: The best-supported local geometry reproduces the source-reported UC-1, UC-2 and UC-3 bond/angle pattern at the qualitative level supported by the disclosed route.
items.expected: The submission reports named local observables for all three states and supports shorter Li-O/Si-O than the Li/F/Si-free Fe-activated Zn-O baseline, Al-F lengthening and angle changes; exact Table S7 values are not treated as a unique target because functional, PAW and author coordinates are undisclosed. Assess complete like-for-like shells/distributions, not a target-nearest angle. Treat site-dependent disagreement with its evidence; do not require the hidden historical occupation or exact Table S7 geometry.
